# Gemma 4 references

`dense/`, `moe/` and `unified/` contain deterministic, small BF16 weight checkpoints and independently computed CPU F32 layer states and logits. They are generated by `scripts/gemma4_reference.py` with Transformers 5.20.2 and torch 2.14.1. They exercise 512-dimensional proportional global RoPE, sliding windows, PLE, K/V sharing, double-width MLPs, unified K/V and learned expert routing scales. They are numerical architecture oracles, not real model checkpoints.

`e2b/config.json`, `e2b/headers.json` and the canonical template/tokenizer special-token metadata come from [`google/gemma-4-E2B-it@3e22461f65e89153144f8adb70e3b8c2cc9845a7`](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-E2B-it/tree/3e22461f65e89153144f8adb70e3b8c2cc9845a7). The header fixture contains only text-tower tensor names, dtypes and shapes, read from the published SafeTensors header. It contains no checkpoint tensor payloads. `templates.json` is generated by the pinned Transformers Jinja renderer from that canonical template and its special-token context.

`e4b/`, `12b/`, `26b-a4b/` and `31b/` contain publisher configuration snapshots from 2026-10-25. These sizes have not been executed or validated against their full weights. Their sources are the corresponding Google repositories:

- https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-E4B-it
- https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-12B-it
- https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it
- https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-31B-it

The real E2B golden is generated separately into the path named by `TUR_GEMMA4_GOLDEN`; it is not included in the offline suite. It includes the source revision and reference-library versions in SafeTensors metadata.
